guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 申请主网测试资格
guide.description: 打开 Wager Predict 测试页面，连接钱包并申请名额。申请会绑定你连接的钱包，因此请使用你打算用于交易的钱包。如果此前参加过测试网活动，请连接当时使用的同一个钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the Wager Predict beta page and connect your wallet to request a spot. The request is tied to the wallet you connect, so use the one you plan to trade with. If you farmed the testnet, connect that same wallet.

guide.title: 浏览开放的预测市场
guide.description: 等待期间可以打开 Markets（市场）页面。所有人都能查看市场，因此在获得交易资格之前，你可以先了解市场分类、赔率和到期时间。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Markets page while you wait. Markets stay visible to everyone, so you can study the categories, odds, and expiry dates before you are able to trade.

guide.title: 查看访问资格状态
guide.description: 使用同一个钱包返回测试页面，查看你所在的批次是否已获得访问资格。团队尚未公布各批次的开放时间表。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Return to the beta page with the same wallet to see whether your cohort has been admitted. The team has not published a schedule for cohorts.

guide.title: 进行首次主网预测交易
guide.description: 获得访问资格后，选择一个市场，选择 YES（是）或 NO（否），再输入金额。此时的交易会使用 BNB Chain 上的真实资金。根据白皮书，每笔买入和卖出均收取 2% 的手续费；每个市场会在到期前一小时停止交易。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Once admitted, pick a market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Trades now use real funds on BNB Chain. The whitepaper sets a 2% fee on every buy and sell, and trading on a market closes one hour before it expires.

guide.title: 查看徽章与排行榜名次
guide.description: 打开 Achievements（成就）页面，查看徽章进度。共有 23 枚徽章，涵盖下注次数、交易量、胜率、利润、连胜、创建的市场和排行榜名次等指标。网站说明，每枚徽章都会增加用于计算 $WP 分配的积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Achievements page to follow your badges. The 23 badges cover bet count, volume, win rate, profit, win streaks, markets created, and leaderboard rank, and the site says each one adds points toward your $WP allocation.

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
相关活动信息待核实，请查看官方公告。

risks: 项目尚未确认空投，存在投入后无回报的可能。
真实性置信度偏低，证据不足，建议先观察。
任何要求输入助记词、私钥或恢复短语的页面都不可信。

sourcedDescription: The airdrop is confirmed in the official tokenomics: 10% of the 30 billion $WP supply goes to retroactive airdrops and community campaigns. The team has not said how testnet points convert or whether mainnet beta activity counts toward the snapshot, and it states that final distribution terms will be confirmed closer to TGE.
tagline_en: The airdrop is confirmed in the official tokenomics: 10% of the 30 billion $WP supply goes to retroactive airdrops and community campaigns. The team has not said how testnet points convert or whether mainnet beta activity counts toward the snapshot, and it states that final distribution terms will be confirmed closer to TGE.

sourcedSteps.title: Request Mainnet Beta Access

sourcedSteps.title: Browse the Open Markets
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Markets page while you wait. Markets stay visible to everyone, so you can study the categories, odds, and expiry dates before you are able to trade.

sourcedSteps.title: Check Your Access Status
sourcedSteps.body: Return to the beta page with the same wallet to see whether your cohort has been admitted. The team has not published a schedule for cohorts.

sourcedSteps.title: Place Your First Mainnet Prediction
sourcedSteps.body: Once admitted, pick a market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Trades now use real funds on BNB Chain. The whitepaper sets a 2% fee on every buy and sell, and trading on a market closes one hour before it expires.

sourcedSteps.title: Track Badges and Leaderboard Rank
sourcedSteps.body: Open the Achievements page to follow your badges. The 23 badges cover bet count, volume, win rate, profit, win streaks, markets created, and leaderboard rank, and the site says each one adds points toward your $WP allocation.
